relations.rationale: Whether Gus booked the hall has no bearing on Dev's suggestion about the herb section.
Leo's arrival timing relative to Mina is unrelated to whether he was wearing work boots.
Leo showing up shortly after Mina is consistent with and sets up his later action of setting down chairs, but doesn't itself establish it.
Leo arriving shortly after Mina says nothing about when Ben arrived relative to Mina.
Leo's arrival time relative to Mina has no bearing on the group packing up chairs later.
Leo's footwear from an earlier job is unrelated to Ben's arrival time relative to Mina.
Leo's boots have no bearing on whether everyone agreed the garden was in good shape.
Leo setting down chairs is unrelated to a height comparison between Dev and Ben.
Leo setting down chairs near the entrance has no bearing on team membership.
Leo's action with chairs is unrelated to the group's discussion of raised bed layout.
Leo setting down chairs earlier supports the later claim that the group packed up chairs together, since chairs being present is a precondition for packing them up.
A height comparison between Dev and Ben is unrelated to team membership between Mina and Leo.
Dev's height relative to Ben has no bearing on whether Leo is on Dev's team.
Height comparison is unrelated to garden layout discussion.
Dev's height compared to Ben has no bearing on Mina's team relative to Dev.
Height comparison is unrelated to Ben's reminder about the watering schedule.
Dev being taller than Ben has no bearing on Dev's shift preference.

If Mina is on the same team as Leo, and Leo is not on Dev's team, this is consistent but doesn't directly establish 14 from 10 alone; however assuming 10 true supports the plausibility that Leo's team differs from Dev's if Mina and Dev are different, but strictly from A alone there's no info about Dev.

If Mina is on the same team as Leo, and Leo is not stated in relation to Dev here, but if Mina were on Dev's team then Leo would also be, so this makes Mina not being on Dev's team more plausible only if combined with other facts not present here.
Ben arriving later than Mina does not determine his arrival time relative to Gus.
